added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest has empty baseline_suite and after_suite fields; the completed 96-test head gate in resumed-named-tests.log has no failing IDs, so its added-failure set is empty against any baseline, but no paired baseline suite arm was recorded.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Missing the new row, rereading more than appended bytes plus 128 KiB, or storing a digest different from an independent read of the actual consumed file fails one of these assertions.
Scanning or reading an unchanged source fails the zero-scan and zero-byte assertions.
A fixture replacement that changes no bytes, changes length, or falls inside a probe window fails these fixture validity assertions.
Skipping the first metadata-changed tick or rebuilding the middle rewrite before the interval fails these assertions.

Verifying on the due idle tick, skipping the later append, failing to replace the stale sample, or storing a digest unlike the actual source fails the corresponding assertion; the due-tick skip contradicts the declared timing measure.
A malformed head fixture, no scan, a missing or repeated probe, or retaining the old sample after the head rewrite fails the corresponding assertion.
Opening an unchanged reboot-spanning source fails the updated open-count assertion.

findings.text: blocking: A same-length middle rewrite changes mtime, but a pre-interval tick records that new mtime and later due ticks skip the file, so the rewrite is never detected without another append.
blocking: An unchanged first tick after process restart leaves _hashes empty; the next append performs a whole-prefix read and can exceed the k plus 128 KiB bound for a tick after the first.

justifications.evidence: resumed-named-tests.log:6 records 96 passes, but tests/test_telemetry_index.py:1523 asserts a skip where prompt.txt:93 requires due middle-rewrite detection.
